description: Search Rightmove for sale, rental, new-build or student property anywhere in the UK, or fetch listings from Rightmove URLs and property IDs.

furnishType.description: Furnished or unfurnished filter for rental and student searches. Sale searches ignore it.
furnishType.title: Furnishing

includeLetAgreed.description: Also return rental listings marked Let Agreed. Applies to to-rent and student searches.
includeLetAgreed.title: Include let agreed

includeSSTC.description: Also return sale listings marked Sold Subject To Contract. Applies to for-sale and new-homes searches.
includeSSTC.title: Include sold subject to contract

location.description: UK city, town, region, outcode or postcode (for example `London`, `Manchester`, `Stoke-on-Trent`, `SW1A` or `SW16 1QA`). Used by every mode except `byUrl`.
location.title: Location

maxBedrooms.description: Largest number of bedrooms to include. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxBedrooms.title: Maximum bedrooms

maxItems.description: Maximum number of property records to return (1-2000).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Highest asking price or rent in GBP. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (GBP)

minBedrooms.description: Smallest number of bedrooms to include. 0 means no minimum.
minBedrooms.title: Minimum bedrooms

minPrice.description: Lowest asking price or rent in GBP. Leave empty for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (GBP)

mode.description: What to search: properties for sale, properties to rent, new-build homes, student accommodation, or a specific Rightmove URL/ID. Legacy values such as `forSale` and `toRent` still work.
mode.title: Search mode

mustHave.description: Require a garden or parking. Leave as No requirement to include everything.
mustHave.title: Must have

propertyType.description: Restrict results to one property type. Leave as Any type for all types.
propertyType.title: Property type

radius.description: How far around the location to search. Postcode searches usually need a radius above This area only.
radius.title: Search radius

sortBy.description: Order of results, matching Rightmove's own sort options.
sortBy.title: Sort order

startUrls.description: One or more Rightmove search-page URLs, property-page URLs, or bare numeric property IDs. Used by mode `byUrl`; pasted search filters are preserved.
startUrls.title: Rightmove URLs or property IDs

title: Rightmove UK Property Scraper Input
